messages:
opsbot: ALERT · Incident IN-789 · cedarbridge-prod · funcall parser errors detected in dedicated pool cedarbridge-dp-1 — elevated 5xx rate, paging oncall. Details: <link-to-alert>
liz_cedarbridge: We started hitting failures around 22:12 UTC — our billing job fails to complete tool calls. Seeing a lot of NACKs and timeouts. This is impacting invoice generation for a subset of customers.

liz_cedarbridge: Sample sanitized payload pasted here (DMed full payload to @tim_h):
```json
{
  "request_id": "***",
  "tool": "invoice-processor",
  "params": {
    "items": [{"sku": "A1", "qty": 2}],
    "customer_id": "ced-123"
  }
}
```

tim_h: Ack, I'm on pager. Paging @jamie_sre and @maria_s for triage. Thanks for the payload, @liz_cedarbridge — very helpful.

jamie_sre: joining. tailing cedarbridge-dp-1 logs now. can you confirm whether this started after a deploy or any schema changes on your side?

liz_cedarbridge: We did a small change to the invoicing webhook yesterday around 20:00 UTC — added an `items` array to support bundles. Unknown if that would cause the toolcall to break on your end.

maria_s: looking at logs: parser in runtime expects `params.items` as a stringified CSV in older contract. New inbound type is array -> we get exceptions. snippet from runtime error:
```
2026-03-14T22:12:34Z ERROR parser - KeyError: 'items' at parse_toolcall (parse.py:87)\n  payload: { ... }
```

jamie_sre: Confirmed it's hitting a KeyError path in our deserializer. Stacktrace shows `parse_toolcall` path failing when it tries to `split()` a str field. Repro locally by sending the array payload — runtime throws same exception.

tim_h: Is this isolated to cedarbridge-dp-1 or wider?

jamie_sre: Isolated to cedarbridge dedicated pool (cedarbridge-dp-1). No other tenants reporting. Likely tenant-specific payload change.

maria_s: Mitigation options: 1) ask Cedarbridge to revert/patch their webhook, 2) add a temporary compatibility shim in our parser to accept array and transform to previous shape, 3) route Cedarbridge to a compatibility variant of the model that accepts the new payload (if available).

tim_h: Need quick fix to stop customer impact. Option 2 seems fastest. Can we patch runtime to coerce `params.items` -> join to string or extract main fields? We'll need canary first.

jamie_sre: I'll prepare a minimal shim that checks for list and maps to the expected string path (join SKUs). Will do a canary roll to 2 hosts in the pool first. Deploy command:
```
# canary rollout
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/serve cedarbridge-parser=registry/redwood/parser:shim-cedarbridge-abc123
```

opsbot: Deployment started for IN-789 (canary 2/20). CI link: <link-to-deploy>

liz_cedarbridge: If that helps, we can also temporarily reduce your request timeout and retry logic on our side. We want minimal risk to downstream jobs.

tim_h: Good idea. @liz_cedarbridge can you increase client-side retries to 3 for now? We'll keep the shim and monitor.

liz_cedarbridge: Done — set retries to 3. Watching system now.

jamie_sre: Canary (2/20) reports: no parser exceptions on incoming payloads. Error rate for cedarbridge-dp-1 decreased in the canary hosts. Metrics:
- pre-fix 10m error rate: 12.3%
- canary hosts: 0.6%

jamie_sre: Rolling patch to remaining hosts in the pool now. will keep traffic leak small for 5m then 100%.

opsbot: Alert update: severity reduced to P2 for IN-789. Notifying customer success to keep Cedarbridge updated.

maria_s: After full rollout, 10m sliding error rate for cedarbridge-dp-1 down from 12.3% -> 0.7%. No other tenants affected. Leaving telemetry on for 2 hours.

liz_cedarbridge: Confirmed — our invoice jobs resumed successfully, backlog processing restarted. Thank you all :heart: This was blocking end-of-day jobs.

tim_h: Handoff: I'm leaving a runbook and follow-ups for morning SRE. TODOs: add schema-contract test to Redwood CI for cedarbridge sample payloads, add a warning in model routing if tenant sends unexpected types, schedule sync with Cedarbridge API team to agree on long-term contract. Adding action item to IN-789 ticket.

jamie_sre: Notes saved to ticket IN-789, sanitized payloads attached. Also added `compat-shim` flag in runtime config so we can toggle per-tenant if needed.

opsbot: Incident IN-789 mitigated and moved to monitoring. Please file a postmortem within 72 hours. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria_s: Postmortem draft will include timeline, root cause (consumer-side schema drift), detection (parser exceptions), mitigation (runtime compat shim + client-side retries), and long-term remediations (contract tests + schema validation). I'll own the PM.

liz_cedarbridge: Appreciate the fast response. We'll follow up on our API change plan and coordinate a contract versioning approach to avoid recurrence.

tim_h: Thanks team. If anything regresses ping this thread. I'll follow up with owners on the postmortem and schedule the sync with Cedarbridge API next week.

:thumbsup: reactions from @maria_s @jamie_sre :heart: from @liz_cedarbridge
